title: Mixed Event — An Ode for the Pure of Heart — Episode8 Smiles and Dreams

meta.Event: An Ode for the Pure of Heart
meta.Event Outline: Toya suddenly ends up taking on a role as a wedding flash mob extra. But when he arrives at the venue, unexpected circumstances mean that the director is nowhere to be seen. As the possibility of a canceled show grows greater by the second, Toya meets Rui...

rows.Line: The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (A lot happened yesterday, but I'm glad everything went well in the end...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I need to thank Akito too... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Haha. Cheer up, Akito!
I mean, you danced up a storm yesterday...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You came to visit Akito too, Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Yeah, yesterday was a ton of fun and I wanted to talk about it more!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But Akito hasn't really been in the mood.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm not used to doing stuff like that, so I'm more tired than usual...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But you two were an enormous help yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You went along with what I asked without asking any questions. I promise to pay you back...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No, you don't have to do that!
How'd it go? Quid pro quo?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Wait, I can make you get me pancakes and stuff...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You greedy little...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What's that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe. I see.
Then we can go get some after school.
Hello. Fancy seeing you all here...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What the?! When did you get here...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Kamishiro?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I came to thank you all for yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Tsukasa was planning to come too, but had to go to a committee meeting. He'll probably be here once it's over.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, I spoke to him last night. I'm glad he's feeling much better now.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I have to think that he's easier to deal with when he's forced to mellow out a little like that...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But thanks to you, we were able to put on a wonderful performance. I appreciate your efforts.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That show actually even gave me an idea for my next show. I need to thank you for that as well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, I'm glad that we could help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, it was so much fun too.
Just ask again if you need our help!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Count me out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I do owe you a favor, don't I, Shinonome? There may even come a time when you need my help. Who knows?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm only getting bad vibes from that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If you were to help us...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It'd be nice to have you help us make our dream come true someday.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Your dream? The one about surpassing that event...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, that might be nice...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I really only specialize in theatre, but please feel free to ask when you would like me to help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll do whatever I can to make your event as spectacular as it can be.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So that the people who come to see your show all go home smiling.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, we'll be looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now, if you'll excuse me...
Oh, also...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I recommend opening the windows in your classroom in just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh? Uh, sure...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Did you tell Kamishiro about RAD WEEKEND, Toya?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I mentioned it vaguely.
He wished us the best.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cool...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I only ever talked to him as a hall monitor whenever I had to question him, but he's actually a pretty good guy, huh?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, he isn't as bad as I thought he would be...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, lunch is almost over.
I'm gonna head back now...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?! What the...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was that an explosion?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line:
Wait, an explosion...
Is it them again?!

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: Look! I think they're flower petals! They're all over the school!

rows.Speaker: Teacher's Voice
rows.Line:
It's them again!!!!
Find Tenma and Kamishiro!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Speak of the devil...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. I guess “normal” isn't really their thing, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: Hey...!

rows.Speaker: Student's Voice
rows.Line: The petals are coming in through the windows! They're so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Is this what Kamishiro truly loves doing?)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The thing that he's always thinking about and never compromises for... Making others smile...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: This gave us an opportunity to look at performing from a different perspective...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We have to make the most of this experience and keep getting better.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Toya's getting fired up!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, we got everyone going in the end, so I guess it wasn't all bad...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I hope we'll be able to put on an event that moves people like that someday...
